Black Friday at the mall, and one booth has the deal of the year: 50% off. Four married women walk up to it one by one, Hinata, Bulma, Sakura and Chi-Chi, while their husbands push them in or wait outside, and every one of them comes back to her man messy, torn up and dripping, with a few words about who the real man is now~ Chapter 2 is already out on my Patreon! comic by Amadeus V.
If you want your own comic, support me, or read my newest sets — check me out here: https://www.patreon.com/amadeus_v

ショッピングモールのブラックフライデー、半額ブース。ヒナタ、ブルマ、サクラ、チチ、人妻たちが一人ずつブースへ。ぐちゃぐちゃになって夫のもとへ帰ってくる〜 寝取られ。第2話はPatreonで公開中！（Amadeus V）
